title: Numbing Creamy German Cabbage Stew
description: A comforting, low-carb German classic re-imagined with a spicy, numbing kick of Sichuan peppercorns and finished with a rich, velvety beurre-monte.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the shredded cabbage and ground Sichuan peppercorns, stirring constantly until the cabbage starts to soften and char slightly at the edges.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a rapid boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for twenty minutes until the cabbage is completely tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and let the stew simmer gently uncovered for five minutes.
In a separate small saucepan, bring two tablespoons of water to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and whisk in the cold, cubed butter one piece at a time to create a thick, emulsified beurre-monte.
Remove the stew from the heat and gently fold in the warm beurre-monte to enrich the broth.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste before serving hot in bowls.
